# Sound list

Every sound the game can use. Drop the file under `assets/sound/` and add `'sound/<name>.mp3'` (or `.m4a`) to `assets/assets.js`. Anything missing stays synthesized (sfx, ambience) or silent (music). Volumes: settings sfxVolume / ambienceVolume / musicVolume.

**41 files, 0 hand-made so far.** Generated by `tests/assets.html` from the game code on 2026-10-14 — do not edit by hand; re-run the page.

| Section | Files | Done |
|---|---|---|
| Sound effects | 25 | 0 |
| Ambience beds | 7 | 0 |
| Music | 9 | 0 |
